description: This file provides utility functions for managing access and refresh tokens in browser local storage, including storing, retrieving, normalizing, and clearing tokens. It also handles legacy key migration for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: normalizeStoredToken
methods.description: Normalizes a stored token string, returning null if the token is missing, empty, or a string that indicates absence ('null', 'undefined').

methods.name: stripBearerPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'Bearer ' prefix from a token string if present, returning the raw token or null.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token from local storage, handling legacy key migration if necessary.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored refresh token from local storage.

methods.name: setTokens
methods.description: Stores provided access and refresh tokens into local storage, after stripping the Bearer prefix if present. Also updates legacy keys for backward compatibility.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes all token-related keys from local storage to log out the user.

methods.name: hasAnyToken
methods.description: Checks if there is any valid (non-null, non-empty) access or refresh token stored.
